parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides more precise personalization (specific monthly discretionary income calculations, timelines tied to user's numbers) and keeps all recommendations at low risk_level consistent with the user's conservative tolerance, whereas System A's Rec #3 and #4 assign moderate risk_level without strong justification for a 3/10 loss-comfort investor. System B also offers more concrete, executable steps (specific dollar amounts, TreasuryDirect account, HR questions) and grounds claims like the I-Bond rate and 401(k) match more traceably.
